sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1 OF 2000
AD
HOC MEMBERS OF THE SHARIAT APPELLATE BENCH (ALLOWANCE FOR ATTENDING OF
SITTINGS) ORDER, 2000.
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1
OF 2000
An
Order to provide for payment of allowance to ad hoc members of the Shariat
Appellate Bench
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd March, 20001
F.No.2(2)/2000-Pub., dated
22-3-2000.---The following Order made by the President is hereby published for
general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the Ad Hoc Members of the
Shariat Appellate Bench (Allowance for Attending of Sittings) Order, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Sitting alolwance

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1 OF 2000
AD
HOC MEMBERS OF THE SHARIAT APPELLATE BENCH (ALLOWANCE FOR ATTENDING OF
SITTINGS) ORDER, 2000.
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1
OF 2000
An
Order to provide for payment of allowance to ad hoc members of the Shariat
Appellate Bench
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd March, 20001
F.No.2(2)/2000-Pub., dated
22-3-2000.---The following Order made by the President is hereby published for
general information:--
2. Sitting allowance.--There
shall be paid to an ad hoc member of the Shariat Appellate Bench of the Supreme
Court, appointed from out of the panel of Ulema an allowance of two thousand
rupees per diem while attending the sittings of the Bench subject to the
condition that the total amount of such allowance paid in a month shall not
exceed one month's salary of a Judge of the Supreme Court.

3. Travelling allowance.--Where
an ad hoc member travels from his ordinarily place of residence to an
outstation place for attending sitting of the Bench he shall be entitled to the
travelling allowance as admissible to a Judge of the Supreme Court in addition
to the sitting allowance payable under Article 2.
